_comment: Golden set for the RAG retrieval gate. In-scope items must NOT be refused (top score >= threshold); items with expectSource must surface that source in top-k. Out-of-scope items MUST be refused.

history.text: Aigram is a self-hosted web client for my own Telegram account with an AI layer built in: summarize a chat, translate, generate images and handle voice notes without leaving the conversation.
Python on Telethon, a FastAPI backend serving a vanilla-JS PWA on the same asyncio loop, with Gemini as the primary provider and OpenRouter as the fallback.
Aigram turns my own Telegram account into a self-hosted AI messenger, with a co-pilot in every chat.
Keeping the account safe: a single audited module is the only place that writes to Telegram, with FloodWait-safe pacing.
ScrapeGPT یه ابزار استخراج داده از وب با کمک AI هست که خودم ساختم؛ مدل سلکتورها رو پیشنهاد می‌ده و برنامه اون‌ها رو روی HTML واقعی چک و درست می‌کنه.
اینکه وقتی حدس مدل اشتباهه هم داده برگرده: سلکتورها دوباره روی صفحهٔ واقعی اجرا می‌شن و اگه نخورن، ساده‌تر می‌شن.
PromptAmp is my browser extension that turns a rough draft into an engineered prompt inside any text field, using your own API key.
Anyone who types requests into AI tools and wants better results without leaving the page.
